title: Site realization of a normalized coefficient counit mate
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell
e p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and $1\le m\le n$. Set $A=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi^n)$, $B=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi^m)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. For a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $Y$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], write $a_Y:Y	o s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $F_{Y,R}=Ra_{Y,R!}\dashv G_{Y,R}=a_{Y,R}^{	imes}$, $\omega_{Y,R}=G_{Y,R}R_s$, and $\varepsilon_{Y,R}:F_{Y,R}\omega_{Y,R}	o R_s$, for $R=A,B$, on ordinary small etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-amb-etale-compact-support, thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Let $T_Y=-\otimes_A^LB$ [def-kun-derived-tensor], and denote the canonical compact-support coefficient comparison by $c_{Y,K}:T_sF_{Y,A}K	o F_{Y,B}T_YK$ [lem-fix-compact-support-coefficient-change]. Here bounded constructible finite-Tor means constructible cohomology, zero outside a finite interval, and integers $a\le b$ such that tensoring with every degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Let $Z$ also be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $f:Y	o Z$ be a separated finite-type $k$-morphism and let $F_R=Rf_{!,R}\dashv G_R$ be its ordinary etale compact-support adjunction at $R=A,B$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support, thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Write $c_{f,K}:T_ZF_AK	o F_BT_YK$ for the canonical compact-support coefficient comparison [lem-fix-compact-support-coefficient-change]. Let $N\in D^b_{ctf}(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, assume $G_AN$ and $G_BT_ZN$ are bounded constructible finite-Tor, and let $v:T_YG_AN	o G_BT_ZN$ have adjunct $(T_Z\varepsilon_{A,N})c_{f,G_AN}^{-1}$. For $W=Y,Z$ let $S_{W,R}=
u_W^*$ be site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. On finite constructible etale-origin pro-etale objects let $J_R=S_{Y,R}G_RR
u_{Z,R,*}$ carry exactly the transported Hom bijection [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image, lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. Use the comparison unit for $\alpha_{R,H}:S_{Y,R}G_RH\cong J_RS_{Z,R}H$ and the canonical coefficient tensor comparisons $t_{W,K}:S_{W,B}T_WK\cong T_W^{\mathrm{pro}}S_{W,A}K$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Then the map
$$v^{\mathrm{pro}}=J_B(t_{Z,N})\alpha_{B,T_ZN}\,S_{Y,B}(v)\,(T_Y^{\mathrm{pro}}(\alpha_{A,N})t_{Y,G_AN})^{-1}$$
is the transpose of the transported coefficient/counit composite under this specified Hom bijection. It is invertible whenever $v$ is, and this transport preserves the actual counit identity and every identity or successive-coefficient cocycle obeyed by the $v$, under the specified coherent tensor identifications. For $f=a_Y$ and $N=A_s$, the object comparisons are exactly the finite dualizing comparisons $S_{Y,R}\omega_{Y,R}\cong\omega_{Y,R,\mathrm{proet}}$ [lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison]. No claim is made about exceptional adjunctions on arbitrary pro-etale complexes.

proof.text: For each supplied bounded-below tensor model M, apply exact open extension to its universal scalar unit. The proper coefficient tensor-unit universality theorem then shows that compact support of M, with the compact-support coefficient restriction unit, is itself a universal tensor presentation of compact support of the input. These are the already proved openTensorUnit_universal and properCoefficientTensorUnit_universal calculations of [lem-fix-compact-support-coefficient-change]. This constructs MF explicitly, rather than choosing data from an existence theorem. Its comparison is invertible by compactSupportCoefficientComparisonPlus_isIso. The boundedness of G_A N and G_B MN follows directly from their assumed bounded constructible cohomology intervals. The comparison unit is invertible at N and MN by [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison], so functoriality gives both alpha isomorphisms.

The two compact-support comparisons used by [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison] and [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] agree literally. Expand their proper and open factors. The fully faithful inclusion of D+ sends the exact open comparison, its composition isomorphisms and inverses to the corresponding unbounded comparisons. Naturality of the proper right-derived inclusion comparison moves the open comparison across it. Both remaining proper factors are the same fixed counit mate. This proves compactSupportComparison_eq without imposing an equality on freely chosen isomorphisms.

Evaluate ComparisonClassAdjunction.homEquiv_normalized at a bounded-below K and H. For h:F_B K -> H, naturality of the comparison unit identifies its comparison-adjunction image with h followed by eta_H. Naturality of the ordinary etale adjunction in H therefore sends d_K followed by S(h) to S(hat h) followed by alpha_H. Use sourceIso and tensorSiteIso to transport the bounded-below etale-origin witnesses to the actual source and target. Naturality_left and naturality_right then identify the transpose of realizedWord with realizedMate. Every factor is invertible when v is invertible. Finally apply injectivity of the same Hom equivalence to the claimed counit identity: naturality_left sends the inverse image of the identity after P(realizedMate) to realizedMate, which is the transpose already computed. No ambient pro-etale adjunction is used.

Expand finiteDualityObjectMap and finiteDualityBaseUnit of [lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison]. The latter is eta followed by U of the fixed constant-unit transport. Functoriality of G and S identifies the displayed map with alpha followed by J of baseUnitTransport. This is equality of the specified maps, with no replacement of any defining data.

Expand transport. For identity coefficients, use the assumed tensor-unit compatibility and naturality of ep at the source endpoint inverse, then cancel the endpoint isomorphism. For successive coefficients, functoriality expands both transported maps, the intermediate endpoint cancels, and naturality of tBC moves vAB through it. Apply the given ordinary coefficient cocycle and tensor coherence, then naturality of ep at a.inv. These calculations are transport_identity and transport_cocycle and apply to arbitrary categories.

For the actual tensor coherence use the generic, already proved comparisonScalarComp helper from Sheaf.Paper.NormalizedOriginComparisonCoherence. Its arbitrary-ring composition calculation applies directly to phi, psi and psi.comp phi: comparison restriction is coherent under composition of actual restrictions by adjunction conjugation; exact derived descent preserves that equation; the mates equivalence preserves horizontal pasting, giving the scalar-extension equation for the compositors of [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility] and [def-weil-pbc-normalized-origin-scalar-comparisons]. Cancel the invertible direct comparison to convert its inverse-comparison form into tensorCoherence. This argument needs no flatness or boundedness. Expanding realizedMate, sourceIso and tensorSiteIso, functoriality and inversion of composites give realizedMate_transport, connecting the abstract identity and cocycle equations to the actual arrows.
